hook_text: 07:30 to 14:15. Is that 6 hours 85 minutes? Clocks do not work like that.
clip_script: School calendar time! School runs from 07:30 to 14:15. How long? Do not subtract! Count on. 07:30 to 08:00: 30 minutes. Then 6 jumps of an hour to 14:00. Then 15 minutes more. 6 hours 45! Heritage Day? 1 September is a Monday. Jump by 7: 8, 15, 22. Then 24 is a Wednesday! And 1994 to 2024? 30 years. Three decades!
visual_style: A colourful wall calendar and a timeline with jumping arrows, the clock hands spinning as hours are counted.
mood: Organised and upbeat, like a class planning session.
pacing: A quick wrong answer, a clear count-on, then fast calendar jumps.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and count the days until your birthday.
